text:
Here are the Qi2.2 25W power banks in the search results, with US availability.

## Available to buy in the US

**Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh)**
- It has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging and a 45W USB-C port, and it recharges at 30W in about 1.5 hours. ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html))
- The price is $59.99 at Baseus, or $53.99 with code AM52, which Dealectric last tested on 2026-10-24. Notebookcheck's February report listed $79.99 on Amazon US, so that price may be out of date. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/qi2-2-25w-power-bank-released-2026-official-manufacturer))
- [Buy it here](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy.
- Dealectric says 25W needs an iPhone 16 or later (not the 16e) on iOS 26. Older iPhones get 15W.

**Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh, A110R)**
- It has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, an active cooling fan, a 45W USB-C port, a smart display and a built-in stand.
- It costs $109.99 and is on pre-order, shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. Anker lists compatibility as iPhone 13 to 17, except the 16e. ([Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910))

**UGREEN MagFlow 25W**
- It was announced in July 2025 as the first WPC-certified Qi2.2 power bank, with sales planned on UGREEN's site and Amazon. ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html))
- The results give no current price or product page, so check UGREEN's store or Amazon for availability.

**ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh)**
- It is 13.8 mm thick and was shown at CES 2026 as a Qi2 25W power bank for the iPhone 17 series. ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html))
- ESR's release says "Qi2 25W" rather than "Qi2.2" by name. It also gives no price or purchase link, so check ESR's site or Amazon.

## Not for the US
**CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K** is a 10,000 mAh Qi2.2 25W bank with a built-in cable. It launched in Japan at ¥8,980 on Amazon.co.jp and Rakuten. ([PR TIMES](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html))

## Which to pick
- **Best value:** the Baseus AM52, at about $54 with the code.
- **Best cooling and features:** the Anker MagGo 2 Pro, but it costs about twice as much and ships later.

All of these need a Qi2.2-capable phone, such as an iPhone 16 or 17 or a Pixel 10 Pro XL, to reach 25W. Anker also advises using a MagSafe-compatible case.
